evidence: Touches src/wallet/ storage, RPCs, and exports, and carries the Wallet label.
rationale: Retaining and exporting multipath descriptors solves a major interoperability hurdle for hardware wallet workflows and BIP 388 multisig registration. As the description notes, tools like HWI require unified multipath descriptors across receive and change paths to register multisig policies and safely verify addresses, which Bitcoin Core currently destroys upon import by splitting them into single-path descriptors.
